intent: A small icon button on a SidebarGroup's caption row acting on the whole section.
typical_uses: An add or configure action beside a section's caption

dont_use_when.situation: An action on one row of a menu

invariants.text: The action is absolutely positioned 12px from the group's right edge, vertically centred on the caption row, as a 20px square sizing a direct `svg` child to the small icon size.
Collapsed to the icon rail the action is not displayed.
It renders a native button with no accessible name of its own; an icon-only action needs `aria-label`.

rtl.by: sidebar.module.css positions .groupAction with the physical `right` property, so it stays on the right edge under a right-to-left direction

render.states: render replaces the rendered element with one the caller supplies
render.because: Base UI's useRender takes an element or a function of the action's own state, so its type is a union of a React element and a callback - the compiler emits one JSON type per property.

bad.title: An icon-only action with no name
bad.why: The button's only content is the icon, so it is announced as an unnamed button; pass `aria-label`.

render.description: TS: ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | ComponentRenderFn<HTMLProps, {}> | undefined. The compiler emits one JSON type per property; this type is left to tsc. render replaces the rendered element with one the caller supplies.
